name: totalrecall-first-wedge-discovery
goal: Identify or reject a non-veterinary first workflow for a durable-memory calling agent using six to eight operator interviews and explicit evidence gates.

nodes.doneWhen: Two priority hypotheses and one skeptical comparison are recorded with falsifiers
A human approves the communication channel, audience, and message before any invitation is sent
Six to eight research invitations are sent only through the approved channel and logged without private customer data
Six to eight operator interviews are completed using the buyer guide without collecting customer data or recordings
Each interview has a complete evidence card and each workflow has supporting and contradictory observations
The scorecard confirms sample count, required gates, and unresolved contradictions for every candidate
The synthesis corrects any unsupported conclusion or declares the missing evidence
A human advances one workflow only if every scorecard gate passes, or explicitly rejects and parks all candidates
One approved call reason, relationship timeline, call policy, escalation path, and 30-day measure are specified
The specification contains every required boundary and contains no unapproved autonomous action
